first.text:
Adding it now. Monday becomes: overhead press, chest supported row, the lateral raise and rear delt fly pair, then incline curl to finish, 3 sets of 8 to 12 at RPE 8 with 60 seconds rest, adding weight once every set reaches 12. The seat goes back to about 45 degrees so the arm hangs behind you and the biceps work from a full stretch; let the elbows stay fixed and curl without swinging.

Nothing else in the week moves. Direct biceps work goes from 6 sets on Sunday alone to 9 across Sunday and Monday, which is where I wanted it for the arms goal.

Before anything is recorded I'll check the change against the rest of the week and come back with the exact starting weight for the curls, drawn from what you were lifting on them under the old routine, plus Monday's time estimate so you can see it still fits inside 75 minutes. You say yes to that, and then it goes in. One moment.
